findings.label: CONFIRMED_LIVE_NON_US_PRODUCT
findings.claim: Coinbase Global Derivatives lists XRP as cross collateral for any cross-margined position in supported regions outside the US; X:SM haircut 15%, X:PM dash/no haircut listed.

findings.label: CONFIRMED_LIVE_NON_US_DERIVATIVE
findings.claim: Coinbase Global Derivatives offers XRP_USDC linear options executed on Deribit infrastructure and settled in USDC; 1,000 XRP per contract; 24/7.

findings.label: CONFIRMED_US_PRODUCT_SCOPE
findings.claim: Coinbase Prime US institutional Global Derivatives uses CFM/Deribit but its current public eligible-collateral list is USDC, BTC and ETH; XRP is not listed.

findings.label: REGULATORY_PATHWAY_NOT_PRODUCT_PROOF
findings.claim: CFTC Letter 26-17 grants conditional staff no-action relief for customer-owned digital commodities/payment stablecoins through CFM/CBBM/Deribit; the referenced digital-commodity interpretation explicitly lists XRP.
findings.caveat: No current public evidence that XRP is accepted as US collateral under this program.

capital_classification.xrp_collateral: Existing XRP posted/encumbered; not proof of new spot purchase
capital_classification.usdc_settlement: Circle-issued USDC used as settlement currency; not proof Circle directly funds the account
capital_classification.rebalancing: Can convert positive XRP equity into a negative settlement currency; potential forced sell channel
